targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at), AVG(final_priority_score) FROM alert_prioritization_scores GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at), AVG(latency_seconds) FROM analyst_acknowledgment_audit GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at), AVG(quality_score) FROM escalation_quality_reviews GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM false_positive_tuning_reports WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT AVG(workload_score) * 100 FROM analyst_workload_snapshots WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at), COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE fatigue_detected = true) FROM operational_fatigue_indicators GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert_recurrence_reports WHERE suppression_candidate = true
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM false_positive_tuning_reports WHERE expiry_tracked = true AND suppression_duration_days <= 7
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at), COUNT(*) FROM investigation_ergonomic_views WHERE status = 'archived' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
